notes.title: New languages ​​and fixes
notes.notes:
In this new patch we have added the following:

·Japanese language has been added

·Russian language has been added

·An error has been corrected that prevented you from gaining rank within the company in certain circumstances.

·An error that prevented progress in task 3 has been fixed.

Thank you all, sorry for the inconvenience due to possible errors. We continue working to improve.

notes.title: Improved graphics and performance.
notes.notes:
The following improvements have been added in this update:

-New conversations with the girls have been added.
-Game performance has been improved.
-Graphics have been adjusted on lower PC configurations.
-Portuguese language has been added to the game.
-Text corrections.
-Bug fixes.

We are working to add new girls, more sex scenes and tasks to improve the office and we will keep working to improve and add more content.
